independent_batch_rule: Each player is classified independently. A failed player remains held and does not block other passing players.
pass_to_deployment_rule: A passing shadow authorizes only a separate A8 exact-scope deployment of the passing subset.
per_player_pass_rule: Exactly one second-source row by frozen FantasyPros ID.
Exactly one second-source row by frozen candidate Sleeper ID.
Both lookups resolve to the same row.
shadow_rule: Only individually passing players may enter the direct/successor shadow.
